title: Papua New Guinea Government Tenders Scraper

mode.title: What to scrape
mode.description: 'All' pulls open tenders, disposal-of-state-assets notices, and awarded contracts in one run. Pick a single type to run just that section.
enumTitles: Disposal of state assets notices only

maxResultsPerType.title: Max results per type
maxResultsPerType.description: Applies to disposals and contracts (both fully paginated on the source site). Open tenders are unaffected -- the source page only ever shows the current handful of open tenders, with no further pages available (see README).

fetchDetails.title: Fetch full detail pages
fetchDetails.description: For disposals and contracts, fetch each record's own page to pull agency, dates, contract value, supplier, and PDF link. Turn off for a faster run that only returns title/link/date.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrent detail-page fetches
maxConcurrency.description: How many detail pages to fetch in parallel per type.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy configuration. Residential is on by default.
